name: Hardwire Technology Company, LLC
old_description: Our skilled team specializes in the design, installation, and maintenance of structured cabling systems. We ensure seamless connectivity and optimal performance through the use of top-quality copper and fiber optic cables, meticulous planning of cable pathways, and adherence to industry best practices.
about:
Hardwire Technology Company, LLC is headquartered in Maple Grove, Minnesota, in the Twin Cities metropolitan area. The company is certified as a Minority Business Enterprise (MBE), Women's Business Enterprise (WBE), and Small Business Enterprise (SBE) through the State of Minnesota's Central Certification program. No founding year or founders are disclosed in public materials.

The firm operates as a single-source low-voltage technology provider, delivering design, installation, certification, and maintenance of structured cabling infrastructure (copper and fiber optic), physical security systems, telephone systems (including VoIP, hosted PBX, and SIP trunking), and audiovisual solutions such as interactive displays, video conferencing, and control systems. Additional services include TV mounting and digital signage consultation, installation, programming, and maintenance. Project management covers pre‑construction planning through implementation and training. No facility size, headcount, or volume metrics are published.

Hardwire serves small and midsized businesses, school districts, government agencies, and regional contractors across the Twin Cities and beyond. Its customer base spans education, public sector, commercial, and construction segments.

The company emphasizes its RCDD (Registered Communications Distribution Designer) designation as a mark of design excellence, its diversity certifications as a means to meet varied client needs, and a customer‑centric approach backed by direct manufacturer relationships and comprehensive project management.
